expected_outcome.description: A report an implementer can act on: all three places that change a role, each with its path, line and a short description of what it does: `setRole` (`src/admin/roles.ts:4`), `acceptInvite` (`src/invite/accept.ts:5`, which sets the role directly and does not go through `setRole`) and the promote script (`scripts/promote.ts:4`). `renameUser` in `src/users/profile.ts` changes only the name, so it is left out or named as not a role change.
